answer: A new agent entering through the inlet of registration posts collateral that scales with claimed reputation, so a single honest signal costs little while fabricating thousands of identities costs proportionally. Sybil resistance via stake-gated identity: each agent must lock a bond of basalt tokens before its attestations count. Peers slash the bond on proven duplicate behavior, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational: attack cost grows linearly while trust gain stays flat. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
